title: QUIZ - 80
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Writing Equations from Slope and Y-Intercept
questions.learningObjective: Write a line's equation given its slope and y-intercept
questions.question: Write the equation of a line with slope -8 and y-intercept -6.
questions.explanation: Using slope-intercept form y = mx + b with m = -8 and b = -6 gives y = -8x - 6.
questions.hint: Substitute the given slope and y-intercept directly into y = mx + b.

questions.concept: Writing Equations from Two Points
questions.learningObjective: Write a line's equation given two points it passes through
questions.question: Write the equation of the line passing through (3, 8) and (4, 6).
questions.explanation: First find the slope: (6-8)/(4-3) = -2. Then use a point to find b: 8 = -2(3) + b, so b = 14. The equation is y = -2x + 14.
questions.hint: First calculate the slope from the two points, then use either point to solve for the y-intercept.
